llcReport.title: File Franchise Tax Report and Public Information Report

feeDetail.note: no tax due at or below $2.65 million of annualized revenue (2026 report)

penalty.note: $50 late-filing penalty applies to a franchise tax report; entities filing only a Public Information Report or Ownership Information Report at or below the no-tax-due threshold have no $50 penalty.

corpReport.title: File Franchise Tax Report and Public Information Report

feeDetail.note: no tax due at or below $2.65 million of annualized revenue (2026 report)

penalty.note: $50 late-filing penalty applies to a franchise tax report; entities filing only a Public Information Report or Ownership Information Report at or below the no-tax-due threshold have no $50 penalty.

entityTaxDetail.summary: 0.75% of taxable margin (0.375% for retail and wholesale); no tax due at or below $2.65 million of annualized total revenue, though the report is still filed

salesTax.permit: Texas Sales and Use Tax Permit

permitFee.note: There is no fee for a Texas sales and use tax permit, though a security bond may be required.

penalty.note: $50 for each report filed late, plus 5% of the tax paid 1 to 30 days late and 10% if paid after that.

workersComp.agency: Texas Department of Insurance, Division of Workers' Compensation
workersComp.threshold: Optional for most private employers (mandatory for public contractors)

unemployment.note: $15 if filed within 15 days after the due date; later reports pay 0.05% of taxable wages plus $30, rising the longer it is late.

newHire.note: $25 for each unreported hire, or $500 for conspiring with an employee not to report.

laborPosters.note: No penalty amount specific to the required workplace notices was found in the state's labor and workers' compensation sources.

workersComp.note: Coverage is elective; non-subscribers lose common-law defenses in injury suits.

local.title: Local permits
local.description: Texas has no general state or city business license; occupancy, health, signage and industry permits are local, and DBAs go to the county clerk.

industry.health: Texas Health and Human Services Commission

cannabis.regulator: Texas Department of Public Safety, Compassionate Use Program
cannabis.note: Texas's compassionate-use program is limited in scope.
